# Tasks Document

- [ ] 1. Dev dependencies, suite fetch and cache
  - Files: pyproject.toml, uv.lock (via uv), scripts/svg_conformance.py (new: header, constants, suite and cache section, `fetch` CLI command), tests/scripts/test_svg_conformance.py (new: offline tests)
  - `uv add --dev resvg_py==0.5.0 numpy`; script skeleton with `ROOT` + `sys.path` insert like screenshot_app.py; `SUITE`, `CACHE`, `fetch`, `suite_folder`, safe extraction into a temp folder with `filter="data"` and `.complete` marker; `argparse` CLI with `fetch`
  - Purpose: the suite on demand (Req 1)
  - _Leverage: scripts/build_package.py `_download`, tests/scripts/test_build_package.py importlib loading_
  - _Requirements: 1.1–1.5_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec svg-conformance-harness, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer experienced with tooling and safe file handling | Task: Implement the "Suite and cache" and "CLI" (fetch only) parts of design.md; offline tests with monkeypatched urlopen: wrong hash writes nothing and names both hashes, crafted tar with `../evil` / absolute member / outside symlink is rejected, complete cache is detected and a second fetch does nothing, incomplete cache (no or wrong marker) is not | Restrictions: tests never touch the network; no Qt; the presstoshape package stays unchanged; speaking names | Success: tests green; real `uv run python scripts/svg_conformance.py fetch` downloads and a second run reports the cache is complete. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 2. Pass list, scope rules, rendering and scoring
  - Files: scripts/svg_conformance.py (pass list and scope, rendering and scoring sections), tests/scripts/test_svg_conformance.py
  - `PassEntry`, `read_pass_list`, `in_scope`, `chapter`, `subchapter`, `THRESHOLD`/`BLUR_SIGMA`/`CHANNEL_TOLERANCE`, `pixels`, `score`, `render_ours`, `render_resvg` with `SANS`
  - Purpose: shared building blocks for report and tests (Req 2.2, 2.4, 3.1–3.3, 3.6, 4.1)
  - _Leverage: render/export.render_png, skia Image/Surface/ImageFilters, resvg_py.svg_to_bytes_
  - _Requirements: 2.2, 2.4, 3.1–3.3, 3.6, 4.1_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec svg-conformance-harness, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer experienced with Skia and numpy | Task: Implement the "Pass list and scope" and "Rendering and scoring" parts of design.md; offline tests: pass-list lines with threshold, comment, both, blank/comment lines, malformed line and duplicate raise ValueError with line number; in_scope examples for each excluded chapter, sub-chapter and a *-dom-* test plus in-scope ones; score of identical renders is 0, size mismatch 1.0, a document missing one large rect scores above THRESHOLD, a 1 px shift scores below; render_resvg and render_ours of the same simple SVG score below THRESHOLD | Restrictions: no Pillow; no Qt; constants carry a short why where non-obvious | Success: tests green. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 3. Checks: test files and generator
  - Files: scripts/svg_conformance.py (checks section), tests/formats/test_svg_generator.py (new)
  - `TestResult`, `check_test` (read with notes, round trip, render, score; reading/round-trip errors recorded), `check_suite` with fnmatch filter, `check_generator` (well-formed, SVG namespace root, resvg vs ours); generator documents covering every savable object and style
  - Purpose: the checks the report and pytest share; generator check on built documents (Req 2.1, 4.2, 4.4, 4.5)
  - _Leverage: formats/svg.py read_svg_with_notes / write_svg / read_svg, tests/helpers.py shape builders_
  - _Requirements: 2.1, 4.2, 4.4, 4.5_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec svg-conformance-harness, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer and test engineer | Task: Implement the "Checks" part of design.md and tests/formats/test_svg_generator.py: focused documents for shapes (rect, rounded rect, ellipse, open/closed paths), fill rules with holes, text with each anchor, groups with opacity, a Composite, transforms incl. rotation and skew, object/fill/stroke opacities, caps/joins/miter limit/dashes, hidden object and hidden layer; each saved and compared via check_generator below THRESHOLD. Add a looser per-test threshold for text only if a run needs it, with the measured value and reason in a comment | Restrictions: catch errors only around reading and the round trip in check_test; do not change presstoshape/ — if a generator document fails because of a real writer bug, stop and report it instead of fixing it here | Success: tests green. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 4. Report, summary and report CLI
  - Files: scripts/svg_conformance.py (report and summary section, `report` CLI command)
  - `write_report` (index.html: chapter/sub-chapter tables, in-scope totals, out-of-scope list, candidates, per-test rows, sheets ours | W3C | resvg for in-scope non-matches, folder cleared first), `write_summary` (deterministic Markdown), CLI `report [--filter] [--write-summary] [--date]` with fetch hint when the suite is missing
  - Purpose: the developer-facing report and the committed baseline (Req 2.3, 2.5–2.8, 5)
  - _Leverage: checks from task 3, render_resvg with resources_dir = suite/svg_
  - _Requirements: 2.3, 2.5, 2.6, 2.7, 2.8, 5.1–5.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec svg-conformance-harness, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer | Task: Implement the "Report and summary" and remaining "CLI" parts of design.md; static HTML with inline CSS, light and dark via prefers-color-scheme, no scripts; HTML-escape all test text (notes, errors); offline tests: write_summary output for a small fixed result list is exactly as expected and identical on a second call, write_report creates index.html and one sheet per in-scope non-match in a tmp folder (sheets via a tiny fake suite folder built in the test) | Restrictions: report output only under build/svg-conformance unless a folder is passed; nothing committed is touched without --write-summary | Success: tests green; a real run over the cached suite prints totals and the report opens in a browser with readable sheets. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 5. Initial pass list, suite tests and baseline
  - Files: tests/scripts/svg_conformance_pass.txt (new), tests/scripts/test_svg_conformance.py (suite tests), docs/svg-conformance.md (generated), CLAUDE.md (one line under Testing), FEATURE_GAPS.md (Level 0 ticked, not committed)
  - Run the report; look through the in-scope matches by eye (sheets or ad-hoc side-by-side) and list the confirmed ones, with comments where needed (e.g. outdated reference); suite tests: names exist, each listed test still matches, each listed test passes the generator check; module skips with the fetch command when the suite is missing; `report --write-summary`
  - Purpose: regressions fail pytest; numbers recorded (Req 3.2, 3.4–3.6, 4.3, 5)
  - _Leverage: report candidates list, check_test, check_generator_
  - _Requirements: 3.2, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6, 4.3, 5.1–5.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec svg-conformance-harness, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Test engineer with an eye for rendering detail | Task: Build the initial pass list from in-scope matches confirmed by eye — exclude tests that match only by accident (e.g. the test's point is something we don't support but the picture happens to agree); write the suite tests as in design.md "pytest modules" with parametrisation from the pass list at collection time and the suite lookup inside the tests; generate docs/svg-conformance.md; add a CLAUDE.md Testing line naming the fetch/report commands and the pass list rule (add tests after checking them by eye; never remove one to make a change pass without saying so); measure the added pytest time | Restrictions: do not change presstoshape/; keep the suite out of git | Success: full `uv run pytest` green with and without the cached suite (move the cache away temporarily to check the skip), added time about a minute or less, report shows no pass-list entry failing. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._
